ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ACME Solar Holdings Limited has announced the commissioning of Phase-III (53.63 MW/214.52 MWh) of its Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project in Rajasthan, bringing the total commissioned capacity to 159.58 MW/638.32 MWh with commercial operation set for October 02, 2026. This represents a significant operational milestone and positive progress towards their 300 MW/1200 MWh project, which is underpinned by a Power Purchase Agreement with SJVN Limited, with no immediate red flags identified.
